decision_conditions: Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in either flank wall of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the first floor and ground floor flats at the property known as 162 Ash Grove. (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include kitchen facilities)

Condition : 6 - The windows formed in both side elevations and the rear elevation shall be modified to be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing, within three months of the date of this permission.
description: Retrospective application for the erection of an outbuilding used as a gym/playroom in the rear garden of a house converted into flats.
